steps.title: Find a destination
steps.text: Type part of a name into the search box, for example plug. The list keeps only the destinations whose name contains the text; Enter opens the first one.

await.hint: Type something into the search box.

steps.title: Every destination
steps.text: This list holds the Getting Started assistant and every settings destination. Each one is the dedicated panel of its tool, kept alive while you look at another.

steps.title: Pick one
steps.text: Click a destination. Its panel fills the area on the right and brings its own Help and Guide buttons.

await.hint: Click any destination in the list.

steps.title: Walk the list
steps.text: Next goes to the next destination, Back to the previous one, and the double arrow visits all remaining ones in order. The status line on the left says what is happening.

steps.title: The panel
steps.text: The hosted panel gets all the remaining space. Its own Help and Guide buttons explain that destination.

steps.title: Help
steps.text: The ? button explains the hub itself; Guide starts this walkthrough again.
